label: Friendly name
summary: Other computers on your network see this server under this name. Leave it empty to use the computer's own name.

label: Send crash reports to Plex
summary: Reports of crashes let us make things work better for you.

label: Scan my library automatically
summary: Keep the library up to date on its own whenever something in a library folder changes.

label: Scan only what changed when changes are found
summary: If a library folder changes, scan just that folder instead of everything.

label: Include music libraries in automatic updates
summary: Linux caps how many folders can be watched at once, so very large music libraries may run into trouble.

label: Empty trash automatically after every scan
Allow media deletion
summary: Lets the server owner remove media files from the disk.

label: Weeks to consider for Continue Watching
summary: Anything left unwatched for longer than this many weeks drops out of Continue Watching.

label: Most items shown in Continue Watching
summary: Caps how many shows Continue Watching lists. A very high number may slow things down.

label: Include season premieres in Continue Watching
summary: The first episode of a new season always shows up, however many weeks it has been since you last watched.

label: Video played threshold
summary: Once playback passes this percentage, the video counts as played.

label: Video play completion behaviour
summary: Choose whether end credits markers decide when a video counts as watched. If a video has no markers, the percentage you picked is used.
enumValues: 0:at selected threshold percentage|1:at final credits marker position|2:at first credits marker position|3:earliest between threshold percent and first credits marker

label: Smart shuffle for artists and smart music playlists
summary: Smart shuffle favours tracks that are well rated, popular or not played lately.

label: Group albums by type
summary: Splits albums by type: LPs, EPs & Singles, Compilations, Live Albums, Demos and Remixes.

label: Cinema Trailers: movies already in my library
Cinema Trailers: new and upcoming movies in cinemas
summary: Needs Plex Pass.

label: Cinema Trailers: new and upcoming movies on Blu-ray
summary: Needs Plex Pass.

label: For movies not in my library, always use English Cinema Trailers.
Movie pre-roll video
summary: The full path of a pre-roll from a registered source. Separate videos with commas to play them in order, or with semicolons to pick one of them. The client must have cinema trailers turned on.

label: Global music videos path
summary: One music video path shared by every music library.

label: Enable iTunes plugin
summary: Changes apply only after the server restarts.

label: Show legacy agents during library setup
summary: Turn on to offer legacy agents when you create a library. Reload the browser page after changing this.

label: A unique identifier for the machine
Has the user accepted the EULA
Words to skip at the start of titles when sorting, separated by commas. Changes apply only after the server restarts.
Highest video resolution the transcoder outputs
Client Network
summary: Which network clients are told about.

label: Secure connections
summary: Even on "Required", a few unencrypted connections from the Media Server computer itself are still accepted, and apps without secure connection support cannot connect at all.

label: Custom certificate location
summary: Location of a PKCS #12 file holding a certificate and private key, used to turn on TLS for a custom domain.

label: Custom certificate domain
summary: The domain name sent to plex.tv along with your mapped port. It has to match a name in the custom certificate file. [IPv4 Only]

label: Preferred network interface
summary: Which network interface clients on your local network connect through.

label: Strict TLS configuration
summary: Turns off old weak ciphers, uses a larger DH group and moves to ECDSA certificates at the next renewal. Older clients may no longer connect.

label: Enable local network discovery (GDM)
summary: Lets the media server find other servers and players on your local network.

label: Publish server on Plex Online
summary: A published server shows up on your client devices on its own, with no router setup needed.

label: Push Notifications
summary: Lets this server send push notifications to mobile devices. Note: these go through Plex services, are tied to your account, and some may reveal what is in your library.

label: Transcoder quality
summary: The quality profile the transcoder uses.
enumValues: 0:Automatic|1:Prefer higher speed encoding|2:Prefer higher quality encoding|3:Make my CPU hurt

label: Segmented transcoder timeout
summary: How many seconds a segmented transcode waits for the transcoder to start writing data.

label: Transcoder temporary directory
summary: Folder for temporary files created while transcoding.

label: Downloads temporary directory
summary: Folder that holds transcoded downloads until the client fetches them.

label: Transcoder default duration
summary: How many minutes to assume when transcoding something whose length is unknown.

label: Transcoder default throttle buffer
summary: Seconds of buffer to build up before the transcoder is slowed down.

label: Transcoder default prune buffer
summary: Seconds of already-played transcode to keep before older segments are removed.

label: Background transcoding x264 preset
summary: The x264 preset for background transcoding (Sync and Media Optimizer). Slower settings give better picture and smaller files but take much longer to finish.

label: Enable HDR tone mapping
summary: With this off, transcoded HDR video looks very dark and washed out. Hardware transcoding with this on may need extra driver components; our support articles explain more.

label: Tonemapping Algorithm
summary: Which algorithm HDR tone mapping uses.

label: Disable video stream transcoding
summary: Stops the transcoder from transcoding the video stream. Audio may still be transcoded, and video may still be remuxed.

label: Use hardware acceleration when available
summary: Plex Media Server will try hardware-accelerated video codecs for encoding and decoding. This can speed up transcoding and allow more transcodes at once, but may lower video quality and compatibility.

label: Use hardware-accelerated video encoding
summary: When hardware acceleration is on, choose whether it also handles encoding, not only decoding.

label: Hardware transcoding device
summary: Which GPU or other hardware device does the transcoding

label: Seconds before a plug-in is given up on
Enable the DLNA server
summary: Serves media to DLNA (Digital Living Network Alliance) players and TVs.

label: DLNA client preferences
summary: DLNA server settings for specific clients.

label: DLNA server timeline reporting
summary: Have the DLNA server report timelines while video plays.

label: DLNA default protocol info
summary: The protocol info string the DLNA server sends in GetProtocolInfo responses.

label: DLNA media renderer discovery interval
summary: Seconds to wait between searches for DLNA media renderers.

label: DLNA server announcement lease time
summary: How many seconds the DLNA server's SSDP announcement lease lasts.

label: DLNA server description icons
summary: Icons the DLNA server hands out when a device asks for the server description.

label: Limit remote stream bitrate
summary: Cap the bitrate of each remote stream from this server.

label: External network total upload limit (kbps)
summary: Total bandwidth cap, in kilobits per second, for everything outside the local network. 0 means no cap.

label: Remote streams allowed per user
summary: How many streams each user may play at once from outside the local network.

label: LAN Networks
summary: IP addresses or IP/netmask networks, comma separated, that count as local for bandwidth limits. If empty, loopback and private networks count as local. Public peers cannot skip limits with a client location flag.

label: Terminate Sessions Paused for Longer Than
summary: In minutes. Sessions left paused longer than this are ended. Audio-only and live sessions are not affected.

label: Treat WAN IP As LAN Bandwidth
summary: Count requests coming from this network's own WAN IP address as LAN for bandwidth. This is common when DNS rebinding protection stops LAN clients reaching the server directly, so they go through the WAN IP address instead.

label: Enable Relay
summary: If the server can't be reached any other way, the Relay connects to it through a proxy relay. Note: the relay's bandwidth is limited

label: Maximum simultaneous CPU transcodes
summary: Cap how many video transcodes your server may run on the CPU at the same time

label: Maximum simultaneous background video transcode
summary: Cap how many video transcodes your server may run at the same time for the optimizer and downloads

label: Enable Plex Media Server debug logging
summary: Debug logging writes extra detail to the log files, which helps track down problems.

label: Enable Plex Media Server verbose logging
summary: Verbose logging only helps with debugging particular issues. Turn it on only when support staff ask you to.

label: Show Plex Media Server tokens in logs
summary: Anyone with a media server token can reach library content, so never post logs that include tokens. Changes apply only after the server restarts.

label: Log Plex Media Server and system memory use (debug logging)
summary: Writes how much memory Plex Media Server uses, and the system's total memory use, into Plex Media Server logs. Changes apply only after the server restarts.

label: Custom server access URLs
summary: URLs (http or https), separated by commas, sent to plex.tv so the server can be found. Include a port with any IPv6 address.

label: IP addresses and networks that need no sign-in
summary: IP addresses or IP/netmask entries, comma separated, for networks that may use Plex Media Server without signing in. If the server is signed out and this is filled in, only localhost and the listed addresses are let in.

label: Webhooks
summary: Lets this server send events to outside services.

label: Time scheduled tasks start
summary: When the server begins its background maintenance tasks.

label: Time at which tasks stop running
summary: When the server stops its background maintenance tasks.

label: Backup directory
summary: Folder where database backups are kept.

label: Remove old cache files every week
Refresh local metadata every three days
Perform extensive media analysis during maintenance
Perform refresh of program guide data.
Marker source
summary: Markers come from local detection on media the source provides. rex never fetches markers from, or sends them to, Plex's cloud database.

label: Generate video preview thumbnails
summary: Uses FFmpeg to make seek previews every 10 seconds. It reads the source video, uses CPU and saves images next to the state database. You can always run Analyze by hand; automatic generation is off unless you turn it on.
enumValues: never:manual analysis only|asap:when media is added

label: Generate intro video markers
summary: Careful intro detection that looks for content repeated across source-placed episodes of one season. You can run Analyze by hand; automatic generation is off unless you turn it on.
enumValues: never:manual analysis only|asap:when media is added

label: Generate credits video markers
summary: Careful detection of scrolling bright credits text on dark backgrounds, plus chapter markers set by the author. You can run Analyze by hand; automatic generation is off unless you turn it on.
enumValues: never:manual analysis only|asap:when media is added

label: Generate ad video markers
summary: Finds ads in movies and episodes.
enumValues: never:never|scheduled:as a scheduled task|asap:as a scheduled task and when media is added

label: Generate voice activity data
summary: Finds where voices are heard in movies and episodes, which helps line subtitles up with the audio. You can switch this per library in that library's advanced settings.
enumValues: never:never|scheduled:as a scheduled task|asap:as a scheduled task and when media is added

label: Generate chapter thumbnails
summary: Uses FFmpeg to make chapter JPEGs at the chapter boundaries the source provides. You can run Analyze by hand; automatic generation is off unless you turn it on.
enumValues: never:manual analysis only|asap:when media is added

label: Analyze audio tracks for loudness
summary: Measuring loudness enables features like loudness leveling and smart transitions. With many tracks it can run for a long time and use a lot of CPU.
enumValues: never:never|scheduled:as a scheduled task|asap:as a scheduled task and when media is added

label: Analyze audio tracks for sonic features
summary: Sonic analysis enables features like track radio. With many tracks it can run for a long time and use a lot of CPU.
enumValues: never:never|scheduled:as a scheduled task|asap:as a scheduled task and when media is added

label: Location visibility
summary: Owners may want to limit who sees place names on items that carry geolocation metadata. Out of the box, only the server owner sees them.

label: Database Cache Size (MB)
summary: Size of the main database cache, in MB. Takes effect after the server restarts.
